description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class named SavingDueTransactionRequest used for encapsulating information related to a saving account transaction (e.g., deposit details). It contains fields for transaction amount, account identifiers, payment details, and related metadata.

classes.name: SavingDueTransactionRequest
classes.description: A serializable data class representing a request to record or process a saving account transaction, including amount, account information, and payment details.
